name: gritql
description_en: GritQL is a query language for searching, linting, and modifying code.
readme_excerpt: Playground | Tutorial | Docs GritQL is a declarative query language for searching and modifying source code. - 📖 Start simply without learning AST details: any code snippet is a valid GritQL query - ⚡️ Use Rust and query optimization to scale up to 10M+ line repositories - 📦 Use Grit's built-in module system to reuse 200+ standard patterns or share your own - ♻️ Once you learn GritQL, you can use it to rewrite any target language: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, JSON, Java, Terraform, Solidity…
